Author: Valentina Vieri
Name: VieriRotationHelper
Punchline: Wrath-parity rotation suggestions for every combat job.
Description: Single-target, AoE, and dynamic suggestion bars with Hilda's side-by-side icon presentation, game frames, outlined hotkeys, positional symbols, and icon cooldowns. No spell-name labels or status banners on the bars. When Wrath Combo is loaded, lead suggestions are read from its live action replacements. This plugin never executes actions.
